FINANS_V2.REPORT_OUTPUT_HELP: Generate a PDF or Excel file using your filters.
FINANS_V2.CATEGORY_HELP: Deactivation preserves past expenses. Inactive entries cannot be selected for new expenses.
FINANS_V2.CATEGORY_SELECT: Select a category to view its items.
FINANS_V2.ITEM_DEFAULTS_HELP: Existing company, quantity, unit, price, currency and VAT defaults are preserved.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_HELP: Overall status across all periods; pick a period to narrow it. Counts exclude cancellations; currencies are never combined.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_CARDS_NOTE: Net amounts by finance date. Income is the invoiced net amount, not cash collected.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_CHART_EMPTY: No accessible chart data for this breakdown.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_SEARCH_ALL_HINT: All periods: project, PO, invoice, company, requester…
FINANS_V2.PANEL_ALL_SEARCH_NOTE: Search covers all financial periods. The date range does not limit this search.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_AGE_NOTE: Day thresholds are cumulative (90+ also falls within 15+); do not add the groups together. PO age starts at initial registration; invoice age starts at the relevant PO item date.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_LOAD_ERROR: Finance data could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.LIST_LOAD_ERROR: The list could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_HELP: Reports cover all filtered server records, not just the current page. Dates use the financial date.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_CATEGORY_ERROR: Expense categories could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_DATES_ERROR: The end date cannot precede the start date.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_ERROR: The report could not be downloaded. Narrow the date range or check export and field permissions.
FINANS_V2.DOC_HELP: POs and invoices entered directly in the application. Attaching a PDF is optional; nothing waits for a document.
FINANS_V2.DOC_ERROR: POs and invoices could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_HELP: Amount-based allocation · Physical quantities and m³ are unchanged.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PO_NOTE: Select a PO first. One invoice may include several projects/work items linked to the same PO.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_NOTE: Allocation uses the net amount excluding VAT. VAT is calculated from the saved line snapshot. You may allocate part of the remaining balance; the server rechecks it when saving.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PO_LIST_ERROR: The PO list could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PO_DETAIL_ERROR: PO details could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_WORK_ERROR: Work records could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_VALIDATION: Enter a number, a date and positive amounts (at most 2 decimals) that do not exceed the open net balance.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_CURRENCY_ERROR: A PO or invoice cannot mix currencies.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_SELECT_PO_ERROR: Select an active PO before creating an invoice.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_SAVE_ERROR: The record could not be saved. Balances may have changed; reload and try again.
FINANS_V2.APPROVAL_PENDING: The request was submitted for approval and has not been applied yet.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_ID_ERROR: The record ID could not be read. Check the list before sending again.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PO_HELP: The PO is entered directly; no document upload is required. Amounts are entered per project × category group.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_EXISTING_PO_NOTE: Select an active PO; the selected work is added to the same PO number as new lines.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_SELECT_TARGET_PO: Select the active PO to add the work to.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PRESELECTED_NOTE: Only the work of the selected row is shown.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_SHOW_ALL_WORK: Show all work awaiting an order
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_GROUP_NOTE: Amounts are entered per project × category group; the server distributes them over the group's items starting from the oldest finance date and re-validates balances when saving. A PO has a single currency.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_PO_SAVED: PO saved. Attaching a PDF is optional; you can add it from the details view.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_PROJECT_STATUS_NOTE: Project status is derived from all of its required items: a project with any item lacking a PO counts as partial, and it is complete only when every item is complete.
FINANS_V2.APPROVAL_QUEUED: The operation was sent for approval and is not applied yet.
FINANS_V2.CURRENCIES_HELP: Finance screens, cards, charts, filters and reports use the active currencies in this list. Currencies are never converted or summed. The code is stored on records and cannot be changed later; deactivate a currency that is no longer used.
FINANS_V2.CURRENCY_CODE_LOCKED: The currency code is stored on finance records and cannot be changed; add a new currency for a different code.
FINANS_V2.CURRENCY_VALIDATION: A three-letter currency code (e.g. USD) and a name are required.
FINANS_V2.DUE_SETTINGS_HELP: A new invoice is due on the invoice date plus the default term and the due date can be changed on the invoice. Unpaid invoices within the warning window are shown as alerts.
FINANS_V2.DUE_SETTINGS_SAVE_ERROR: Due date settings could not be saved.
FINANS_V2.DUE_SETTINGS_VALIDATION: The default term must be 0-365 days and the warning 0-90 days (whole numbers).
FINANS_V2.DUE_DATE_BEFORE_INVOICE: The due date cannot be before the invoice date.
FINANS_V2.DUE_DATE_DEFAULT_HINT: If the due date is left empty, invoice date + {0} days is used.
FINANS_V2.PAYMENT_HELP: Payment information comes from outside: when a payment is received, mark the invoice as paid and enter the payment date. Removing the mark requires a reason; both are written to the change history.
FINANS_V2.PAYMENT_SAVE_ERROR: Payment information could not be saved.
FINANS_V2.PAYMENT_UNMARK_REASON_ERROR: The reason for removing the payment mark must be at least 5 characters.
FINANS_V2.PAYMENT_DATE_ERROR: Enter a valid payment date; it cannot be in the future.
FINANS_V2.PAYMENT_PAID_DAYS_LATE: Paid {0} days after the due date
FINANS_V2.PANEL_RECEIVABLES_NOTE: Amounts are invoice totals including VAT (the amount to collect); the income cards below are net. Unpaid invoices show today's position; paid counts are invoices with a payment date in the selected range. Due soon: due within {0} days.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_AGING_NOTE: Buckets are cumulative (90+ is also in 15+); click one to list its items.
FINANS_V2.PROJECT_DETAIL_EMPTY: This project has no finance items.
FINANS_V2.PROJECT_DETAIL_ERROR: The project detail could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.PROJECT_DETAIL_LIMIT: The project has more than 250 items or invoices; the first 250 are shown.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_RECEIVABLES_NOTE: Rows are invoices; the date range applies to the invoice date. The summary sheet splits unpaid receivables per currency into overdue buckets (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days).
FINANS_V2.REPORT_PREVIEW_HELP: Open the preview to see the rows the file will contain for the selected report type and filters.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_PREVIEW_STALE: The report type or filters changed; refresh the preview before downloading.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_PREVIEW_EMPTY: The report is empty for these filters.
FINANS_V2.REPORT_PREVIEW_ERROR: The preview could not be loaded.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_BLOCK_INVOICED: Fully invoiced ({0}); nothing left to invoice.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_BLOCK_HIDDEN: Cannot be selected because you cannot see its amount.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_BLOCK_CURRENCY: The PO is in {0}; this row is {1}. A PO has a single currency.
FINANS_V2.ALLOC_ALL_INVOICED: Every line of this PO has been invoiced; there is no amount left to invoice.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_TREND_SUB: Month-by-month view of the selected period.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_AGING_SHORT: Items waiting a long time for a PO or invoice; click to list them.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_AGING_EMPTY: Nothing has been waiting longer than 15 days.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_SUB: Click a project to drill down to its crates and items; open any item's record.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_SUB_NO_ITEMS: Project, category and expense breakdown of the selected period.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_ITEMS_EMPTY: The project has no items in this period.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_TRUNCATED: Showing the first 250 items; use Finance Work Tracking for the full list.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_SHARE_AMOUNT: Share is based on job value; the percentage is the category's invoiced ratio.
FINANS_V2.PANEL_DETAIL_SHARE_COUNT: Share is based on the number of work items.

URETIM_V2.PLAN_SELECTION_HELP: Saving a plan stores source crate selections and batch details. Manual crate selections apply to the form you create. The form does not require saving the plan; an unsaved batch number is saved when the form is created.
URETIM_V2.FORM_SELECTION_HELP: Select the crates below to create the production form; it is built from the current data at that moment and downloaded right away in the format you choose (PDF/Excel).
URETIM_V2.ESTIMATE_HELP: Remaining net pine for included crates, after subtracting projects whose production is completed.
URETIM_V2.FORM_HELP: The form is built from the current data when it is created and starts production of the selected crates. Excluded crates cannot be selected.
URETIM_V2.LEGACY_WARNING: legacy completed records have no completion snapshot and are excluded from these totals.
URETIM_V2.CORRECTION_TITLE: Completion correction — the previous version is retained
URETIM_V2.FORM_ERROR: Production form information could not be loaded.
URETIM_V2.REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for this operation.
URETIM_V2.CORRECTION_SAVED: Completion corrected as a new version.
URETIM_V2.COMPLETED_PINE_HELP: Net pine of included crates in projects whose production is completed.
URETIM_V2.FINANCE_DATE_HELP: If entered, it becomes the finance date of the finance items created from the crates on this form; otherwise the production date is used.
URETIM_V2.REGENERATE_NOTE: The selection includes crates that are already on a form; the form is regenerated from current data.
URETIM_V2.REGENERATE_FORBIDDEN: The selection includes crates that are already on a form; you are not allowed to regenerate the form.
URETIM_V2.COMPLETE_FROM_LIST_HELP: To complete production, use "Complete" in the Normal Projects list; all crates included in packaging are completed together.
URETIM_V2.PRODUCED_PINE_HELP: Net and waste pine of closed wooden and cage crates whose production was completed in the selected period.
URETIM_V2.FORM_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The production form was created but the file could not be downloaded; you can try again.

PERMISSIONS.PERMISSION_TYPE_HELP: Screen, action and field permissions work the same way: a child cannot exceed its parent's level, and write access on a parent does not grant its children automatically.
PERMISSIONS.PRIORITY_HELP: Priority: personal deny → personal allow → role → deny by default. Inherit removes the personal decision.

BULK_CRATE_MOVE.TITLE: Move selected contents to another crate
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.NO_TARGET: No other eligible crate is available in this project.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.ATOMIC_NOTE: All selected contents move in one operation. If any row fails, no rows are changed.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.PHYSICAL_NOTE: Moving an allocation does not create a receipt. Only items physically present in the crate are moved.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.LIMIT: Select between 1 and 250 contents per operation.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.INVALID_AMOUNT: Quantity must be positive, at most the allocation in this crate, and have no more than 4 decimal places.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.FAILED: The bulk move could not be applied.
BULK_CRATE_MOVE.NETWORK_ERROR: No response was received. Retrying with the same details will not apply the operation twice.
